subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw make streaming node invokes and node-local Claude CLI agent runs a supported core protocol and configuration contract?
rationale: Even after the mechanical blockers are fixed, this branch adds permanent gateway protocol, node-host configuration, session-placement, plugin-runtime, and execution-security surfaces whose ownership and long-term support require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed design
options.body: Approve the capability after exact approval binding, an internal spawn-resolution seam, upgrade coverage, and real paired-node proof are complete.

options.title: Accept the proposed surfaces
options.body: Explicitly own the broader protocol, config, and public API commitments after documenting their compatibility expectations.

options.title: Pause paired-node execution
options.body: Keep node catalog rows view-only until a smaller or more general remote agent-runtime architecture is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed design
recommendation.body: Approve the capability after exact approval binding, an internal spawn-resolution seam, upgrade coverage, and real paired-node proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history connects this person most directly to the session-catalog product behavior and paired-node continuation design.
